findings.text: follow-on (recorded by the reviewed run, confirmed here): when a raw reading falls exactly on a UTC hour boundary, the raw tier's partitioned total drops that boundary-crossing increment while the compacted tiers' carried openings count it, so raw and its compactions disagree per window and the raw file is retained (the safe direction -- a false-negative eligibility, never a wrong deletion). The semantics live in telemetry_index.py / telemetry_store.py, outside this node's write scope; the shipped tests avoid it with a one-second phase offset.
